test_cases.title: Successful User Sign Up with Valid Credentials
preconditions: User is on the sign-up page
steps: Enter a valid password meeting length and commonality criteria
test_cases.expected_result: Account is created and a confirmation link is sent to the provided email.

test_cases.title: Unverified Account Login and Read-Only Access
preconditions: User has signed up but not clicked the confirmation link
steps: Attempt to perform a write action
test_cases.expected_result: Unverified account successfully logs in and is granted read-only access.

test_cases.title: Sign Up Rejected for Password Under 8 Characters
preconditions: User is on the sign-up page
steps: Enter a password with fewer than 8 characters
test_cases.expected_result: System rejects the password and prevents account creation.

test_cases.title: Sign Up Rejected for Commonly Used Password
preconditions: User is on the sign-up page
steps: Enter a password from the 100 most commonly used passwords list
test_cases.expected_result: System rejects the password because it is commonly used and prevents account creation.

test_cases.title: Unverified Account Automatic Suspension After 7 Days
preconditions: User signed up 7 days ago and has not verified their email
steps: Simulate the passage of 7 days without email verification
Attempt to log in with the unverified account credentials
test_cases.expected_result: Account is automatically suspended and login is denied.

test_cases.title: Unverified Account Remains Unactivated Prior to Clicking Confirmation Link
preconditions: User has completed sign-up with a valid email and password.
User has received the confirmation link email.
User has NOT clicked the confirmation link.
steps: Log in using the newly registered email and password.
Attempt to perform a write or restricted action that requires a fully activated account.
test_cases.expected_result: User is logged in with read-only access and restricted from performing write actions because the account is not yet fully activated.

test_cases.title: Upgrade to Pro plan grants immediate feature access and proration
preconditions: User has an active subscription plan
User is currently on Free tier in the middle of a billing cycle
steps: Initiate an upgrade to the Pro plan
test_cases.expected_result: The charge is prorated based on days remaining in the current cycle and advanced Pro features are accessible immediately.

test_cases.title: Downgrade from Pro to Free takes effect at end of billing period
preconditions: User has an active Pro subscription plan
steps: Initiate a downgrade from Pro to Free
test_cases.expected_result: The downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period, and the user retains Pro features until that time.

test_cases.title: Downgrade from Team to Pro blocked when member limit is exceeded
preconditions: User has an active Team subscription plan with more team members than the Pro plan allows
steps: Initiate a downgrade from Team to Pro
test_cases.expected_result: The downgrade is blocked, preventing the plan change without silently truncating the team members.

test_cases.title: Free-tier user creates projects up to the cap
preconditions: Logged in as a Free-tier user
Current active projects count is 0
test_cases.expected_result: Project is created successfully.

test_cases.title: Free-tier user creates tasks up to the per-project limit
preconditions: Logged in as a Free-tier user
An active project exists with 0 tasks
steps: Initiate creation of a task within the project
test_cases.expected_result: Task is created successfully.

test_cases.title: Free-tier user attempts to exceed the active projects cap
preconditions: Logged in as a Free-tier user
Current active projects count is 3
steps: Initiate creation of a new project
test_cases.expected_result: Upgrade prompt is shown.

test_cases.title: Free-tier user creates exactly the maximum allowed active projects
preconditions: Logged in as a Free-tier user
Current active projects count is 2
test_cases.expected_result: Project is created successfully, reaching the limit of 3 active projects.

test_cases.title: Free-tier API rate limit exceeded
preconditions: Logged in as a Free-tier user
60 API requests have been executed within the current minute
steps: Send an additional API request to create a project or task
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 429 response with a retry-after header is returned.

test_cases.title: Free-tier user attempts to exceed the 50 tasks per project cap
preconditions: Free-tier user is logged in
Project already contains 50 active tasks
steps: Initiate creation of a new task in the project
test_cases.expected_result: Task creation is blocked and an error or limit restriction is shown

test_cases.title: Free-tier user sends API requests exactly at the rate limit threshold
preconditions: Free-tier user is authenticated
API rate limit counter is reset for the user
steps: Send 60 API requests within a 1-minute window
test_cases.expected_result: All 60 API requests succeed without returning a 429 status code

test_cases.title: Free-tier user exceeds API rate limit by sending 61 requests in a minute
preconditions: Free-tier user is authenticated
User has sent 60 API requests within the current 1-minute window
steps: Send the 61st API request within the 1-minute window
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 429 response with a retry-after header is returned

test_cases.title: Pro/Team tier user exceeds API rate limit by sending 601 requests in a minute
preconditions: Pro/Team tier user is authenticated
User has sent 600 API requests within the current 1-minute window
steps: Send the 601st API request within the 1-minute window
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 429 response with a retry-after header is returned

test_cases.title: Successful invitation of a teammate with Admin role
preconditions: The actor is logged in as a Team-plan account owner
steps: Navigate to the team management page
test_cases.expected_result: Teammate receives an invitation and is assigned the Admin role upon joining.

test_cases.title: Successful invitation of a teammate with Editor role
preconditions: The actor is logged in as a Team-plan account owner
steps: Navigate to the team management page
test_cases.expected_result: Teammate receives an invitation and is assigned the Editor role upon joining.

test_cases.title: Successful invitation of a teammate with Viewer role
preconditions: The actor is logged in as a Team-plan account owner
steps: Navigate to the team management page
test_cases.expected_result: Teammate receives an invitation and is assigned the Viewer role upon joining.

test_cases.title: Account owner transfers ownership to an Admin
preconditions: The actor is logged in as a Team-plan account owner
Target user holds the Admin role
steps: Select transfer ownership option for the target Admin
test_cases.expected_result: Ownership is successfully transferred to the selected Admin.

test_cases.title: Admin attempts to remove the account owner
preconditions: The actor is logged in as an Admin
steps: Attempt to remove the account owner
test_cases.expected_result: Action is prevented and an error or restriction is enforced.

test_cases.title: Owner account deletion triggers automatic transfer to longest-tenured Admin
preconditions: Team has multiple Admins with different tenure lengths
Owner account is active
steps: Initiate deletion of the account owner's account
test_cases.expected_result: Ownership automatically transfers to the longest-tenured Admin.

test_cases.title: Prevent a user from holding multiple roles simultaneously in the same team
preconditions: The actor is logged in as a Team-plan account owner
The target user already holds the Editor role in the team
steps: Attempt to assign the Viewer role to the target user who already holds the Editor role
test_cases.expected_result: The system prevents assigning a second role or replaces the existing role to maintain exactly one role per team.

test_cases.title: Admin attempts to transfer account ownership
preconditions: The actor is logged in as an Admin
Another Admin exists in the team
steps: Attempt to initiate an ownership transfer to another Admin
test_cases.expected_result: The system blocks the ownership transfer action because the actor is not the account owner.

test_cases.title: Owner account deletion transfers ownership to the longest-tenured Admin among multiple Admins
preconditions: The team has an account owner
Admin A joined the team on January 1, 2023
Admin B joined the team on June 1, 2023
test_cases.expected_result: Ownership automatically transfers to Admin A, the longest-tenured Admin with the earliest join date.

test_cases.title: Grant full Pro features during 14-day trial
preconditions: User is eligible for a trial (one-time per account based on verified email)
test_cases.expected_result: User receives full Pro features during the trial period.

test_cases.title: First charge occurs on day 15 when payment method is added
preconditions: User has started the 14-day Pro trial
steps: User adds a payment method during the trial
Observe account status and billing on the day the card is added
test_cases.expected_result: Adding a payment method during the trial does not result in an immediate charge, and the first charge occurs on day 15.

test_cases.title: Prevent second trial signup with the same verified email
preconditions: User has already completed or used a 14-day Pro trial with a verified email
steps: User attempts to re-sign up for a trial using the same verified email
test_cases.expected_result: Re-signing up with the same verified email does not grant a second trial.

test_cases.title: Automatic downgrade to Free on day 14 if no payment method is provided
preconditions: User started the 14-day Pro trial and added no payment method
steps: System checks for payment method addition and processes account status on day 14
test_cases.expected_result: Account automatically downgrades to Free on day 14.

test_cases.title: Export all account data before deletion
preconditions: User is logged into their account
steps: Select the option to export data
test_cases.expected_result: Data is exported in a machine-readable format

test_cases.title: Request account deletion and initiate grace period
preconditions: User is logged into their account
test_cases.expected_result: Account deletion request initiates a 24-hour grace period

test_cases.title: Cancel account deletion during the grace period
preconditions: User has requested account deletion
The 24-hour grace period is active
steps: Select the option to cancel account deletion
test_cases.expected_result: Account deletion is canceled successfully

test_cases.title: Permanently purge data after grace period expiration
preconditions: User has requested account deletion
The 24-hour grace period has expired without cancellation
steps: Wait for the grace period to expire without performing a cancellation
test_cases.expected_result: Data is permanently purged after the grace period expires

test_cases.title: Team-plan export by non-owner member
preconditions: User is a non-owner member of a team-plan
steps: Trigger a team-plan data export as a non-owner member
test_cases.expected_result: Export includes only that specific member's tasks and excludes the rest of the team's data

test_cases.title: Opt out of non-security notification type
preconditions: User is authenticated and accessing notification settings
steps: Modify toggle for a non-security notification type to opt out
test_cases.expected_result: Preferences are updated successfully

test_cases.title: Attempt to disable security-related notification
preconditions: User is authenticated and accessing notification settings
steps: Attempt to modify toggle for security-related notification (e.g., password changes or new device login) to disabled
test_cases.expected_result: Security-related notifications cannot be disabled and the toggle remains enabled or an error/prevention occurs

test_cases.title: Digest email scheduled time with user timezone set
preconditions: User is authenticated and has a local timezone set
test_cases.expected_result: Digest emails are sent at 9am local time based on the user's timezone

test_cases.title: Preference change applies to next scheduled notification without retroactive effect
preconditions: User is authenticated and notifications are already queued
steps: Modify toggle to opt out of a notification type
test_cases.expected_result: Changes take effect for the next scheduled notification without retroactively affecting already queued ones

test_cases.title: Digest email defaults to UTC when user timezone is not set
preconditions: User is authenticated
User timezone is not set in profile settings
steps: Configure or trigger a digest email subscription
Check the scheduled delivery timestamp in the digest queue
test_cases.expected_result: Digest email is scheduled for 9:00 AM UTC

test_cases.title: Digest email is scheduled for 9am in specific user timezone (PST)
preconditions: User is authenticated
User timezone is set to Pacific Standard Time (PST)
steps: Inspect the scheduled dispatch time in the notification queue
test_cases.expected_result: Digest email is scheduled at 9am in the user's local PST timezone

test_cases.title: Preference change does not affect already queued notifications
preconditions: User is authenticated and has a notification already queued in the system
Notification type is currently enabled
steps: Toggle the notification type to opt out
Observe the delivery status of the already queued notification and the suppression of subsequent notifications
test_cases.expected_result: The already queued notification is still delivered and subsequent notifications are suppressed
